outcome: Rupture of thyrocervical trunk aneurysm into the thoracic cavity
cohort: A 33-year-old woman with neurofibromatosis type I who experienced a thyrocervical trunk aneurysm rupture three days after a Cesarean section.
finding: Endovascular coil embolization and thoracic drainage successfully treated a ruptured thyrocervical trunk aneurysm causing massive hemothorax and hemorrhagic shock in a patient with neurofibromatosis type I.
mod_finding: The thyrocervical trunk aneurysm rupture occurred three days after a Cesarean section, with pregnancy and puerperium identified as additional risk factors for such ruptures in patients with neurofibromatosis.
